source_location: Original four-page publisher indexed PDF, pp 2593–2596; all text, Table 1, Figures 1–3 captions, methods, results, conclusion and references reviewed. PDF bytes and figure pixels unavailable.
limitations: Three independently reviewed states: one control and two initial treated fabrics. The source cotton contains about 10% polyester, so no exact 90/10 composition or pure-cotton identity is inferred. Areal density conflicts between 110 g/m² and GSM 200; both are preserved and canonical density is blank. Exact T10 is not a zero-loss onset; the text calls T10wt% onset, but canonical Tonset is left blank. DTG temperatures and separate DSC endotherms are preserved only in raw fields and are not used to create additional TG observations. The TG method explicitly calls its assay thermogravimetric but names TA Instruments DSCQ10 (Differential Calorimeter TA), an unresolved instrument identity; no corrected instrument is invented. Nitrogen, 10 °C/min, 100 mL/min, 8–10 mg and alumina crucibles are explicitly stated by this source. The source reports 0.15 M monomer and 0.015 M AIBN; no recipe is borrowed from related PVPA paper, which uses a different monomer and native mM units. N-(hydroxymethyl)acrylamide binder amount, post-rinse drying conditions and retained coating add-on are not specified. Phosphorus 1.62/2.34% is measured elemental content, not coating add-on. Parenthesized LOIs 22.8/26.2 are after one home laundry, not error bars; those washed states have no assigned TG and remain held. Mandatory hot distilled-water rinse in preparation does not denote that later home laundry. The control exact LOI/T10/DTG/R600 tuple repeats in DOI 10.31788/RJC.2022.1547069 and is proposed only in this earlier 2022 source; the related paper control stays reuse-held. Related 2009 APP/PER/melamine and 2016 washable-fabric sources remain excluded under their unresolved source identifiers; no family-wide exclusion is inferred. Complete original indexed publisher PDF text is cached; direct PDF bytes returned 403 and screenshots failed, so no PDF document hash or pixel verification is claimed.
sample_state: CF; untreated supplied fabric control, no finish or durability wash assigned
washing_state: Untreated control; no durability wash assigned
treatment_method: Supplied commercial fabric used as received. No finish, curing, treated preparation rinse or durability laundry is assigned to the untreated control.
pairing_evidence: Table 1 identifies CF with own measured LOI 18.5, T10 327 °C and char yield 6.1%. Thermal prose explicitly assigns the char yield to 600 °C. Both own methods expressly assay the corresponding fabric. Untreated control is proposed only here; exact same tuple in related PVPA2022 is reuse-held.
